# VOLT Paywall V1 — Self-Hosted Web3 Crypto Payment Gateway

> High-performance, non-custodial Web3 USDT (BEP-20) Payment Gateway & Paywall running on Cloudflare Workers edge network with 0% platform fees.

## Overview
- **Product Name**: VOLT Paywall V1 Commercial Kit
- **Price**: 29.00 USDT (One-time payment, lifetime unlimited commercial license)
- **Accepted Cryptocurrencies**: USDT (BEP-20 on BNB Smart Chain)
- **Hosting Cost**: $0/month (Runs completely within Cloudflare Free tier: Workers + D1 SQLite + KV)
- **Settlement Speed**: ~3 seconds (instant on-chain block confirmation)
- **Custody**: 100% Non-custodial (All funds settle directly peer-to-peer into the creator's personal BSC wallet)
- **Platform Fees**: 0.00% (No recurring cuts, no basis points, keep 100% of gross revenue)
- **KYC Requirement**: Zero KYC, zero identity verification, no company registration required

## What is Included in the $29 USDT Commercial Kit
1. **Full Source Code**: 100% editable React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS frontend and Hono.js Cloudflare Worker edge backend.
2. **Autonomous Blockchain Engine**: 4-node BSC RPC failover pool (Binance Dataseed, Defibit, Ninicoin, LlamaRPC) with anti-replay hash protection and BigInt 18-decimal exact math.
3. **Cryptographic Delivery**: Single-use, time-expiring HMAC-SHA256 download access tokens and cloud deliverable streaming.
4. **Interactive Studio & Embed Generator**: 1-click embed generation for HTML buttons, iframes, WordPress shortcodes, Shopify, and Notion.
5. **D1 SQLite Database**: Anti-replay transaction index preventing double-spending and live merchant orders dashboard.
6. **Commercial License**: Unlimited client and personal deployments with 0% royalty fees.

## Target Audience
Creators, developers, SaaS founders, agency owners, and digital merchants looking to replace Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, Stripe, or PayPal to eliminate 5%-10% transaction cuts and account freeze risks.

## Key Features & Comparison
- **Gumroad**: 10% fee + $0.30 per sale, 7-14 day payout hold, custodial.
- **Lemon Squeezy**: 5% + $0.50 per sale, payout delays, custodial.
- **VOLT Paywall**: 0.00% fee, instant 3-second BSC payout, 100% non-custodial, self-hosted on Cloudflare.
